study.title: A dataset of aligned RGB and multispectral UAV imagery for semantic segmentation of weedy rice.
study.short_title: WeedyRice-RGBMS-DB: 734 aligned RGB+MS pairs; SAM2 annotation; no metrics

segmentation.domain: dataset-description paper (Data in Brief) introducing WeedyRice-RGBMS-DB: pixel-aligned RGB + 4-band multispectral (Green, Red, Red Edge, NIR) UAV imagery with binary polygon masks of weedy rice in rice paddies; no segmentation model is trained or benchmarked in this paper
segmentation.best_model: N/A - dataset-contribution paper; no segmentation model evaluation reported

dataset.name: WeedyRice-RGBMS-DB (Mendeley, 10.17632/vt4s83pxx6.1): 734 high-resolution RGB images (1280x960 after resize) with geospatially pixel-aligned 4-band multispectral counterparts (Green 560+-16nm, Red 650+-16nm, Red Edge 730+-16nm, NIR 860+-26nm), binary polygon weedy-rice masks generated by a fine-tuned Segment Anything Model and expert-reviewed/corrected
dataset.note: DJI Mavic 3 Multispectral (M3M; 4/3 RGB CMOS 5280x3956, 1/2.8-inch MS 2592x1944) flown at 12 m and 20 m AGL, 70% front/side overlap, 09:30-15:30 clear daylight; rice fields in An Giang province (Mekong Delta, Vietnam), three consecutive cropping seasons Jun 2024 to Jan 2025. 1471 RGB + 5884 MS images captured; 760 selected for annotation (expert LabelMe + fine-tuned SAM2, SIFT+affine MS alignment to 2400x1800 then resized 1280x960); 734 retained after coverage filter (<90%); weedy rice coverage 31.7% average (range <5% to ~90%).

mIoU.ambiguity: No model benchmark reported - dataset-description paper.

issues: Data-description paper (Data in Brief); no segmentation model is trained or benchmarked - all RQ1 accuracy metrics and edge metrics are absent by design.
Dataset utility: aligned RGB-MS enables multimodal semantic segmentation / weed detection benchmarking, but no reference results are given.
Annotation via fine-tuned SAM + expert review; 26 of 760 candidate images discarded (>90% weedy-rice coverage); 734 final RGB+MS pairs (2936 band TIFFs).
Class imbalance acknowledged (moderate-infestation images over-represented); average weedy rice coverage 31.7%.
Two flight altitudes used (12 m and 20 m AGL); no GSD reported.
